info.title: Languify API
info.description: REST API for the Languify language-learning app: auth & onboarding, course content, lesson progress & gamification (XP, streak, badges, chests, daily quests), avatar, profile, multi-course enrollment, trivia, weekly leagues, Family plan sharing, admin-managed ads, and the gem/heart/subscription shop.

servers.description: API server (paths are relative to this host)

get.summary: Get the active admin-managed ad creative pool
get.description: The frontend picks one at random for each ad placement (sidebar banner, lesson-complete interstitial). Empty until an admin uploads at least one image.

post.summary: Register a new account
post.description: Creates the user (unverified) and emails a 6-digit OTP. No auth cookie is set until /auth/verify-otp succeeds.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Asia/Karachi. Drives streak/daily-reset day boundaries.

post.summary: Verify the registration OTP
post.description: On success, marks the account verified and sets the auth cookie, same as /auth/login.

post.summary: Resend the registration OTP
Log in with email and password
post.description: Sets an httpOnly session cookie carrying a Sanctum token on success.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Asia/Karachi. Refreshed on every login in case the user has traveled.

post.summary: Request a password reset OTP
post.description: Always returns a generic success message, whether or not the email exists, to avoid leaking which emails are registered.

200.description: If the email exists, a reset code was sent

post.summary: Reset the password using the emailed OTP
Log out (revokes the current token and clears the cookie)

get.summary: Get the currently authenticated user
Get the user's DiceBear avatar configuration
get.description: Returns all-null fields if the user has never saved an avatar (the frontend applies its own defaults in that case).

put.summary: Save the user's DiceBear avatar configuration
put.description: Each submitted value must be either the free default for that attribute or something the user has already unlocked with gems.

422.description: One or more values are not unlocked yet

get.summary: Get the full gem-purchasable avatar option catalog, grouped by attribute
get.description: Every option is either the free default for its attribute or something the user must buy with gems before they can equip it.

post.summary: Spend gems to permanently unlock an avatar option
post.description: Pure wallet transaction — no Stripe involved. Once unlocked, an option stays unlocked forever and can be freely re-equipped at any time via PUT /api/avatar.

422.description: Unknown option, already unlocked, or not enough gems

get.summary: Get daily and streak chest availability

post.summary: Claim the daily chest
post.description: Unlocks 24 hours after the previous claim (no XP requirement). Grants a random 10-20 gems.

post.summary: Claim the earliest unclaimed streak milestone chest
post.description: Milestones: 3/7/30/100/365 days, each claimable once.

post.summary: Claim a unit's bonus chest
post.description: Available once the unit's first lesson is completed. Grants random gems/XP/hearts.

403.description: Unit does not belong to the user's selected course

422.description: Chest not available (already claimed or first lesson not done)

post.summary: Submit a contact form message
post.description: Public — no authentication required. Stores the message for admin review.

message.example: I have a question about billing.

get.summary: List all active languages available for native/learning selection

post.summary: Select (or switch to) a native/learning language pair
post.description: Also upserts a user_courses enrollment row for the learning language, marking it active and deactivating any other course.

post.summary: Save the user's self-reported proficiency level
Save the user's daily streak goal

get.summary: List chapters for the user's currently selected learning language
List the alphabet/character set for the user's currently selected learning language
get.description: Purely a reference screen (tap a character to hear it) — not gated by any chapter completion and does not affect chapter locking.

get.summary: List units within a chapter

403.description: Chapter does not belong to the user's selected course

get.summary: List lessons within a unit

403.description: Unit does not belong to the user's selected course

get.summary: List exercises within a lesson
get.description: Each exercise's instruction text is localized into the user's native language.

403.description: Lesson does not belong to the user's selected course

get.summary: List every language the user has ever enrolled in
get.description: Includes per-course chapter completion progress. One course is marked active at a time.

post.summary: Switch the active course to a language the user is already enrolled in
post.description: Also syncs users.learning_language_id and users.native_language_id (each course remembers its own native-language pairing) so every other endpoint, including the UI language, follows the newly active course.

get.summary: Get the current user's family plan status

200.description: Family plan status (owner, member, or none)

post.summary: Invite someone to join the family plan by email

delete.summary: Remove a member from the family plan

post.summary: Leave the family plan you're a member of

get.summary: Look up an invite by token (public — shown before login on the accept page)

post.summary: Accept a family plan invite

get.summary: Get the current user's hydrated game state
get.description: Applies any pending daily-counter reset, streak-break detection, and passive heart regeneration before returning. Day boundaries use the user's own reported timezone.

post.summary: Lose one heart immediately
post.description: Called the instant an exercise is answered incorrectly (not batched at lesson completion). Floored at 0.

get.summary: Get the days in a given month with at least one completed lesson
get.description: Powers the Activity Calendar. Days are computed in the user's own timezone.

get.summary: Get the current user's league standing
get.description: Global (not per-course) weekly leaderboard. Requires a course to be selected first, same gate as Trivia, even though leagues themselves aren't course-scoped.

post.summary: Record a lesson completion
post.description: Awards XP (+ perfect bonus), advances the streak, detects unit completion (one-time +20 XP bonus), and checks all 14 badges — all in one DB transaction. Hearts are NOT deducted here — they are lost in real time per mistake via POST /api/game-state/lose-heart while the exercise is in progress; this endpoint just reports the current hearts value. Replaying an already-completed lesson awards 0 XP and no badges (anti-farming).

streakMilestoneHit.description: The earliest unclaimed streak milestone, if any (claim via /api/chests/streak/claim)

403.description: Lesson does not belong to the user's selected course

422.description: No course selected, or validation error

get.summary: Get a public content page (Terms, Privacy Policy, Contact Us)
get.description: Public — no authentication required. Content is admin-editable HTML.

patch.description: Called opportunistically by the frontend when the browser-detected timezone differs from what's stored, so streak/daily-reset day boundaries follow the user even if they travel mid-session.

get.summary: List languages the user has fully completed
get.description: A language is marked complete when every chapter of that course is finished. Snapshots the lifetime XP at the moment of completion.

get.summary: Get the current user's daily quests
get.description: Assigns a random set of 3 active quests for today on first call (persists for the rest of the day), then returns each with live progress computed from the user's game state.

post.summary: Claim the reward for a completed daily quest

404.description: Quest assignment not found for this user

422.description: Not completed yet, or already claimed

get.summary: Get the shop catalog
get.description: Gem packs, gem-priced heart refill tiers, and Stripe subscription plans.

post.summary: Start a Stripe Checkout Session to buy a gem pack
post.description: Real money via Stripe test/sandbox mode. Gems are credited by the /api/stripe/webhook handler once payment completes — not by this endpoint.

200.description: Checkout URL to redirect the browser to

get.summary: Verify and finalize a gem checkout on return from Stripe
get.description: The Stripe webhook is the primary way gem purchases get credited, but it requires a publicly reachable URL — it can never reach a bare localhost dev server. This endpoint lets the frontend confirm payment directly with Stripe's API the moment the user lands back on the success page, so purchases complete immediately regardless of webhook delivery. Safe to call more than once — a already-completed purchase is a no-op, and payment is always independently re-confirmed with Stripe, never trusted from the client.

403.description: This checkout session does not belong to the current user

post.summary: Spend gems to refill hearts
post.description: Pure wallet transaction — no Stripe involved.

422.description: Unknown tier, hearts already full, or not enough gems

post.summary: Start a Stripe Checkout Session to subscribe to a plan
post.description: Real money via Stripe test/sandbox mode. The subscription is activated by the /api/stripe/webhook handler once checkout completes.

200.description: Checkout URL to redirect the browser to

get.summary: Verify a completed subscription checkout and activate it if paid
get.description: Independently re-confirms the session with Stripe before activating — used as a synchronous fallback to the webhook on checkout return, since the webhook cannot reach localhost in local/dev.

403.description: Session belongs to a different user

get.summary: Start Google OAuth login
get.description: Redirects the browser to Google's consent screen.

get.summary: Google OAuth callback
get.description: Finds or creates the user from the Google profile, sets the auth cookie, and redirects back into the SPA.

302.description: Redirect back to the frontend, logged in

get.summary: Start Sign In with Apple
get.description: Redirects the browser to Apple's consent screen.

post.summary: Sign In with Apple callback
post.description: Apple posts back here (form_post response mode, not a GET redirect like Google). Finds or creates the user from the Apple profile, sets the auth cookie, and redirects back into the SPA.

302.description: Redirect back to the frontend, logged in

post.summary: Stripe event receiver (called by Stripe, not the frontend)
post.description: Verifies the Stripe-Signature header against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Handles checkout.session.completed (credits gems / activates subscriptions), customer.subscription.updated/deleted, and invoice.payment_failed.

get.summary: Get the user's current subscription status

200.description: Current subscription, or null if none active

get.summary: List trivia topics for the user's current learning language
get.description: Always browsable once a course is selected — playing a topic (questions/check/submit) is what's actually locked until Chapter 2 is complete.

get.summary: Get a topic's questions
get.description: The correct answer index is intentionally never included in the response — use POST .../check for live feedback, grading happens authoritatively in POST .../submit.

403.description: Trivia is locked until Chapter 2 is complete

404.description: No such topic for this language

post.summary: Check a single answer, for immediate right/wrong feedback during play
post.description: One-shot per question (subsequent calls for the same question return 409) so a client cannot brute-force the answer key. Never trusted for reward computation — POST .../submit independently re-grades everything from the database.

200.description: Whether the selected option was correct

403.description: Trivia is locked until Chapter 2 is complete

404.description: No such topic/question for this language

409.description: This question has already been checked

post.summary: Submit answers for grading
post.description: Grades server-side from scratch (never trusts prior /check calls). Reward tiers: 100% correct grants 5 minutes of app-wide infinite hearts (every time, even on replays); 80-99% grants a gems/xp bonus (first completion only); below 80% gets only the base per-correct reward (first completion only). Replays are always graded/logged but currency rewards are zero after the first completion.

403.description: Trivia is locked until Chapter 2 is complete

404.description: No such topic for this language

cookieAuth.description: Session cookie set on login/register. Carries a Sanctum token that the AuthenticateFromCookie middleware bridges into the Authorization header server-side.
cookieAuth.name: access_token
